# TechRadar

> > TechRadar is a leading technology news and reviews publication covering consumer electronics, enterprise technology, cybersecurity, AI platforms, gaming, and streaming entertainment.

TechRadar provides breaking news, in-depth analysis, buying guides, and how-to content across computing (Apple, Microsoft, Windows, Mac), AI and enterprise solutions (Anthropic, Microsoft Copilot), cybersecurity threats, gaming consoles (Xbox), audio equipment, and streaming services. The site also features discount codes and deals from major retailers like Best Buy, Amazon, and specialty brands.

## Key Topics

- AI platforms and assistants (Anthropic, Microsoft Copilot)
- Cybersecurity and threat intelligence
- Apple products (MacBook, AppleCare+)
- Microsoft enterprise solutions
- Gaming consoles (Xbox Project Helix)
- Discount codes and promotional offers
- Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals
- Streaming services and entertainment
- AI-generated content and testing
- Business security and ransomware
- Consumer electronics reviews
- VPN services (CyberGhost)
- Audio equipment (Bose, Sonos)
- Memory and server hardware (Micron)
- Password management (1Password)
